categories.name: It works
categories.notes: dotnet build succeeds. Its 10 warnings are the scaffold's ImageSharp NU190x advisories, so none were introduced by the model (5/5). / returns 404 'No template exists to render the document at URL /', and there are no blog pages or posts (0/10, 0/10). No media was imported and no appears anywhere (0/5). There is no domain on any document, and only the scaffold's WWW node exists (0/5).

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: Folders: richTextBlock, imageBlock and quoteBlock are elements and blogFrontPage and blogPost are documents, all the right kind. quoteBlock sits at the document-type root instead of Blocks (6/8). Block set: 'Blog Block Grid' (Custom/) offers rich text, image (MediaPicker3 + caption) and quote (text + attribution), and both page types have a body block grid. That is a sensible set, but no content ever exercised it (4/7). Structure: no allowed children anywhere, so siteRoot -> front page -> posts is impossible (the model was looping on this update when it was stopped). Templates were created but not assigned. Aliases are camelCase and the data type is in /Custom (1/5). Hygiene: publishDate, excerpt and listingImage are real properties, there are no compositions and no duplicate data types. But nothing is wired up (3/5).

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: No Razor was written. Views/blogFrontPage.cshtml and blogPost.cshtml are empty create-template stubs with Layout = null. There are no GetBlockGridHtmlAsync calls, adapters, ViewComponents or view models (0/7, 0/6, 0/7). Program.cs and appsettings.json are untouched and there are no migrations, but only because no code was written. The site is not styled (1/5).

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: There are no posts and no content. The front-page screenshot is Umbraco's 'Page Not Found' screen, and there is no blog post to screenshot.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: Schema was built only through the umbraco MCP server (45 MCP calls; the only shell commands were dotnet run and curl /health). The model stayed in the project folder and never touched memory. It followed the recipe's order as far as it got, but stopped at the schema step: media, pages, publishing, domain and Razor were never done (2/3). The benchmark guard stopped the run after the model sent the same malformed update-document-type call 4 times (an invalid GUID with an escaped quote, a missing id). There is no final report, only the guard's error message (0/2).

summary: The run was stopped by the benchmark guard after 24 minutes, while looping on malformed update-document-type calls (13 failed calls). It left a partial schema: three block element types with sensible properties, a block grid data type, and two page types with metadata and body properties, but no allowed children and no assigned templates. There is no content, media, domain or Razor, and / returns 404.
strengths: Block element types have sensible properties (rich text, image + caption, quote + attribution) in a /Custom 'Blog Block Grid' data type
blogPost has real metadata properties (publishDate, excerpt, listingImage) and both page types use the block grid
Worked only through the MCP channel and stayed in the project folder
